Got it 💙 Here’s the updated version with that added in:  

---

✨ Today my son, Donivan, walked into his *last* first day of high school — senior year! ✨  

I can’t even begin to put into words how proud I am of the young man he has become. To me, he is truly the most amazing young man ever to walk this earth — full of heart, determination, and so much potential. He has so much going for him, and I know deep in my soul that he is going to do incredible things with his life.  

This summer has been life-altering in so many ways, and through it all I pray he carries the strength, confidence, and peace to know that we are going to be okay — because we will. 💙  

As his mom, I find myself praying over him all the prayers a mother’s heart can hold — for protection, for wisdom, for favor, for joy, for strength, for good friends and opportunities, and most of all, for him to always know how deeply loved he is.  

This year is a milestone, and while part of me wishes I could slow time down, the bigger part of me is just so grateful to watch him soar. Senior year, here he comes — and I know he’s going to shine. 🌟  

Love you, Donivan. Always and forever proud to be your mom. 💙  

---
